jobs.title: Sr. Paid Search Manager
jobs.summary: Are you a strategic thinker who loves unlocking growth through data-driven performance marketing? Do you get excited about optimizing campaigns, relentlessly testing new strategies…
jobs.description:
Are you a strategic thinker who loves unlocking growth through data-driven performance marketing? Do you get excited about optimizing campaigns, relentlessly testing new strategies, and uncovering insights that drive massive results? Does scaling acquisition efficiently and automating for impact sound like your ideal challenge? If so, we want to talk.

TurboTenant is looking for a Sr. Paid Search Manager to be a driving force behind our growth engine. You’ll play a key role in building the nation’s best community of landlords by driving high-quality growth through strategic, highly analytical, and creative paid search campaigns.

This isn’t just about managing budgets; it’s about breaking down walls, transforming complex data into a true competitive advantage, and fostering a high-velocity culture of operational excellence across our Performance Marketing team.

Key Responsibilities:

- Paid Search Strategy & Ownership: Fully own, administer, and manage TurboTenant’s entire Google and Bing Ad ecosystem across multiple brands, focusing relentlessly on driving profitable new user signups and customer acquisition.

- Campaign Expansion & Optimization: Lead in-depth campaign expansion and testing. Optimize bidding algorithms, ad copy, and quality scores, while expanding keywords to efficiently scale budgets and hit company-wide growth goals.

- Funnel Mastery & Analytics: Partner with marketing and product teams to identify new opportunities, refine lead loops, and better understand the needs of landlords and tenants to optimize every conversion.

- Strategic Collaboration: Partner directly with Google and Bing representatives to secure custom reporting and gain access to exclusive beta programs. Translate complex channel data into clear insights that explain how paid search impacts the broader business.

Qualifications:

- Experience to Dominate: 4+ years of experience owning Paid Search specifically for B2C companies, with a proven track record of driving profitable revenue and user acquisition.

- Budget Mastery: Demonstrated experience scaling and managing monthly budgets in excess of $300k.

- Analytical & Data Ownership: A passion for clear, concise communication that is consistently backed by data. You can own the accuracy of channel data and build complex analyses.

- Agile & Collaborative Mindset: A collaborative spirit and a willingness to test new ideas, learn from results, and proactively work cross-functionally to drive feature adoption.

- Technical Savvy: Strong foundational knowledge of Google Ads conversion tracking and offline conversion imports.

Technical Bonus Superpowers:

We are looking for someone with a modern, tech-forward approach:

- AI-Native Workflow: You’re ahead of the curve, utilizing AI tools (like Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT) to accelerate your productivity, campaign execution, and data analysis.

- GTM & Tracking Depth: Advanced experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM) for custom event tracking and conversion setup.

- Real Estate Experience: Hands-on experience in residential real estate as a landlord, investor, real estate agent, leasing agent, or community manager is a major plus!

Location & Connection:

Our Performance Marketing team is based in Denver, Colorado. We believe face-to-face connection is vital to our culture, so this is a hybrid role. We’ll look forward to seeing you in person at least once a week on Wednesdays (and more often if you’d like!).

About Us:

At TurboTenant, we simplify the complex and intimidating process of managing your own rental property. And we do it through an elegant software platform for small, “do-it-yourself” landlords and their tenants. But don’t take our word for it—Read reviews from some of our 1 million landlords!

Our Be Better Culture:

At TurboTenant, we live by the Be Better mantra. Our high-performance culture makes us relentless in our efforts to Be Better at serving our landlords and renters, and in unlocking the potential in one another.

What does our Be Better culture mean to you?

- You’ll be in an environment that pushes you to reach your potential.

- You’ll make a massive impact on our landlords, renters, company, and the proptech industry.

- You’ll be on the highest performing team of your career.

We're Proud to Offer:

- Competitive compensation package

- 22 days of PTO during the first year, increasing with tenure

- Annual bonus based on company performance

- Equity – an owner’s mindset is a big part of being a member of the TurboTeam

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans – with multiple plans covered at 100%

- 9 paid holidays per year + a paid day off for your birthday

- 401k Matching

- Annual bike tune-up reimbursement

Compensation: $115,000 - $130,000 + equity. The actual compensation offered will be based on experience.
Salary Range
$115,000—$130,000 USD

Additional Information

TurboTenant is proud to serve a diverse group of landlords and renters. We strive to reflect that diversity within our team. Employment at TurboTenant is based on merit, competence, performance, and business need. TurboTenant celebrates being an equal opportunity employer and never discriminates based on race, color, genetic information, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), age, or any other basis protected by law.

At this time, employer-based visa sponsorship is not available. All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Next Steps

Ready to work on the highest performing team of your career at TurboTenant? Submit your resume and we’ll be in touch soon.

jobs.title: Asset Manager
jobs.location: Atlanta, Georgia, United States; Charlotte, North Carolina, United States; Dallas, Texas, United States
jobs.summary: About Roofstock What we do and why we do it As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosys…
jobs.description:
About Roofstock

What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it’s going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

About the Role

Roofstock is looking to hire an analytical, entrepreneurial, and experienced Asset Manager to join the Mynd Investment Management team. This team player will be intimately familiar with the mechanics of optimizing rental properties, regardless of geographic location, to produce desired outcomes for investments of varying classes, and manage the operational nuances of various investor types. The Asset Management team will apply their expertise to influence all high value operating decisions with the goal of maximizing NOI and helping our investors achieve their goals, all while providing excellent service. The Asset Manager will advise our property managers at a regional market level through all crucial decisions in the investment lifecycle including leasing, marketing, renewals, rent recommendations, revenue management, turns, value-add capex, budget review, variance analysis, portfolio expansion and dispositions. The Asset Manager will play a critical role in monitoring market and investor performance trends to shape strategic initiatives company wide. The Asset Manager will enhance company performance through model maintenance, reporting development, and performance evaluation.

Responsibilities

- Serve as the primary point of contact for Asset Management clients and own accurate, timely weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc performance reporting

- Develop a deep understanding of each institutional partner’s goals and produce recommendations aligned with their investment strategy

- Review portfolio performance to identify trends, diagnose root causes, and recommend strategies that improve NOI, occupancy, revenue, rent growth, renewals, turns, and leasing velocity

- Partner cross-functionally with Property Management, Leasing, Rent Underwriting, Construction, Accounting, Data, Dispositions, and Acquisitions to drive execution against owner goals

- Support annual budgets for large scattered-site SFR portfolios and smaller BTR communities

- Lead monthly budget-to-actual variance analysis by identifying key trends, explaining operational drivers, and partnering with Accounting to validate results

- Leverage Excel, Google Sheets, Sigma, and other reporting tools to analyze large data sets, validate reporting, identify inconsistencies, and turn data into actionable recommendations

- Partner with internal data teams to improve visibility into operational performance through dashboards, KPI reporting, and ad hoc analysis

- Produce financial reports and maintain models for lender tape deliverables and other investor or lender reporting needs

- Monitor recently acquired assets, complete periodic hold/sell analysis, and provide data-driven insights to support acquisition and disposition strategy

- Advise the Buying Team on market trends, real estate opportunities, and buy box strategies

- Develop and improve Asset Management SOPs, workflows, trackers, and templates used by cross-functional teams

- Use AI tools and emerging technologies to improve reporting accuracy, reduce manual work, automate repeatable workflows, and streamline daily tasks while maintaining proper review and validation

- Maintain broad market knowledge, including trends, demand drivers, rents, values, and operating conditions

- Participate in occasional market visits as needed

Qualifications

- 5+ years of asset management experience with multifamily, BTR, or SFR properties

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required

- Strong understanding of SFR, BTR, or multifamily operations, including occupancy, leasing, renewals, turns, pricing, concessions, expenses, and NOI drivers

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, including large data sets, pivots, lookups, formulas, data validation, and ad hoc analysis

- Experience with Sigma or similar BI tools preferred

- Experience building annual budgets, supporting reforecasts, and preparing monthly budget-to-actual variance analysis

- Ability to connect financial results to operational drivers and clearly explain trends to internal stakeholders and institutional investors

- Ability to interface with high-level institutional investors and communicate performance, risks, recommendations, and tradeoffs clearly

- Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive execution across multiple stakeholders

- Excellent organizational, time management, follow-up, written, and verbal communication skills

- High degree of ownership, attention to detail, and bias toward action

- Comfortable with change, technology, ambiguity, and process improvement

- Curiosity and willingness to use AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency while maintaining proper validation and judgment

- Experience working in a high-tempo, high-growth, team-oriented organization

- Solid analytical, problem-solving, and negotiating skills

Location

This role is expected to sit remotely from either Dallas, TX, Atlanta, GA, Charlotte, NC, or Oakland, CA.

Travel Required

Occasional market visits required.

Compensation

$105,000 - $130,000 on annual base salary. This role includes eligibility for quarterly performance incentives tied to individual and/or company performance. The compensation range may be adjusted based on experience and location.

Pay Transparency

Our compensation reflects several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position represents the expected salary for this position. Ultimately, in determining your pay it will be based on several factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience and other job related factors. Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only a part of our total compensation package.

Competitive & Unique Benefits Package

- Generous PTO Policy

- 13 Paid Holidays

- Volunteer Time Off

- Paid Parental Leave

- 401k Program

- Wellness and home office/cell phone subsidies

- Robust health, dental, vision insurance, and more

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment and we are unable to sponsor H1-B Visas at this time.

Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation.

Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

The company provides equal opportunity in all of our employment practices to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender expression, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other category protected by federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all aspects of the employment relationship, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, promotion, transfer, disciplinary action, layoff, return from layoff, training and social, and recreational programs. All such employment decisions will be made without unlawfully discriminating on any prohibited basis.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician II- Corona, Lake Elsinore or Temecula area preferred
jobs.summary: Unlock the Power of You At Invitation Homes, our associates are the foundation of our success.
jobs.description:
Unlock the Power of You
At Invitation Homes, our associates are the foundation of our success. We connect your work to real impact, invest in your growth, and welcome you to feel at home — because care isn't just something we say, it's something you experience.

Invitation Homes owns and operates homes in great neighborhoods across 16 top U.S. markets. We continue to innovate with smart home technology, an industry-leading maintenance app, and other lifestyle-enhancing services that make leasing easier than owning.

Our market teams — Leasing, Property Management, and Rehab, Turns & Maintenance — work together to deliver excellent resident experiences and maintain high-quality homes. Every associate plays a meaningful role in that mission.

Your Role on the Team

As a Maintenance Technician II at Invitation Homes, you will be performing high-quality maintenance work in our single-family rental homes while providing outstanding customer service to our residents. This includes but is not limited to the following tasks:

- Completing maintenance service requests across multiple trades
- Providing excellent customer service and promoting a quality living experience for all residents
- Perform required work while demonstrating respect for resident’s home
- Completing regular ProCare visits in residents’ homes to perform proactive maintenance and repairs- Complete the associated checklist for each visit within its respective mobile app platform.
- At the completion of the visit, schedule the next ProCare Maintenance Visit with the resident through the maintenance mobile app

- Educating residents regarding all maintenance topics by specifically showing webpage of Invitation Homes expectations. (https://www.invitationhomes.com/resident-responsibilities)
- Educating residents on the functional systems of their rental home
- Completing general property condition assessments at all property visits and alerting the property management team when items require immediate attention
- Reviewing and using Technician-specific reports to find opportunities for improvement
- Performing repairs in vacant properties while they are on-the-market or during the turn process
- Properly using and caring for company-supplied tools, materials, and vehicles
- On a daily basis, proactively review the next day’s appointments to ensure the proper equipment, material, information, and allotted time is available to complete the work in a single visit
- Adhere to all Invitation Homes safety guidelines
- Meeting with incoming residents to complete Resident Orientations to welcome them, and educate them on the systems in their home as well as all important maintenance policies and procedures
- May be required to conduct occupancy checks and attend eviction lockouts/setouts in coordination with local law enforcement
- Performing other duties as assigned

Your Experience Includes

- High School diploma or equivalent
- 2-5+ years’ proven experience in residential repairs and maintenance, other building maintenance or related experience
- OSHA 10 is required (new hires will have up to 90 days to complete OSHA 10 certification if not already certified) 
- The following certifications are a plus:- EPA Certification: Type I, Type II, and/or EPA Universal
- HVAC Certification
- CPO certification (pool)

- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills as well as strong verbal and written communication skills; multi-lingual is a plus
- Comfortability using mobile devices (i.e. iPad and/or iPhone) and various mobile applications
- Understanding of residential construction and mechanical systems and ability to perform general repairs in some of the following: plumbing, electrical, carpentry, sheetrock, exterior structural, HVAC (minor) and appliances. Some training will be provided.
- Must possess a current driver's license, automobile insurance, and any other licenses and/or certification as required by state law
- Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis including occasional weekends and holidays
- Ability to provide basic hand and power tools
- Ability to perform work that requires the following:- Frequent climbing, reaching, use of fingers, stooping, kneeling, crawling, pushing, pulling, lifting, talking, and hearing
- Ability to lift and/or move an excess of 50 pounds or more and operate standard maintenance equipment as assigned

Why Invitation Homes
We believe when our residents thrive, our associates thrive. Here, you're not just filling a role — you're building a career at a company that invests in your growth and welcomes you for who you are.

What's in it for you
- Competitive pay and annual bonus program for all associates
- Generous PTO including vacation accrual, sick time, volunteer time, and standard and floating holidays
- 401(k) with company matching contributions
- Casual dress code and a genuinely great work environment
- Team events, celebrations, and a culture that values connection
- Employee Resource Groups: Together with Women, Asian Alliance, Black Collective, Juntos, Gen Next, and Open Invitation
- Career growth paths and learning opportunities — we promote from within

Salary Range
The salary range for this position is: $22.21 - $38.50, plus individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications, location, and applicable employment laws.

Compensation and Benefits
To attract and retain top talent, we're pleased to offer competitive compensation and benefits, including:
- Annual bonus program

- Health, dental, vision, and life insurance

- Long-term and short-term disability insurance

- Generous paid time off plans include vacation accrual, sick time, standard holidays and floating holidays

- 401(k) with company matching contributions

- Awesome work environment with casual dress

- Team events and gatherings (Pre- and Post-Covid)

Invitation Homes is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and innovative environment with the best associates. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at humanresources@invitationhomes.com.

jobs.description:
Who We Are
Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together. Invitation Homes is a place where possibility lives.

The market teams include our Leasing, Property Management and Rehab, Turns & Maintenance professionals. Together, our dedicated associates work hard to build excellent resident experiences while maintaining high-quality homes and ensuring potential residents are presented with a rental property they can’t refuse.

Your Role on the Team
As a Superintendent at Invitation Homes you are responsible for full-cycle oversight of property rehab and turnover efforts. This includes but is not limited to the following tasks:
- Meeting with residents to complete Pre Move-Out Visits and documenting the home condition and resident responsibilities for a successful move-out.

- Meeting with incoming residents to complete Resident Orientations to welcome them, and educate them on the systems in their home as well as all important maintenance policies and procedures

- Conducting Move Out Inspections including a detailed inspection of the property and using our budgeting program to create a comprehensive scope of work and identify costs that should be charged back to the resident at move-out in accordance with company standards

- Overseeing all aspects of the rehab and turn process which includes communicating with contractors, submitting change orders, ensuring work is completed correctly and on schedule, and documenting the process with progress notes and “before” and “after” photos

- Communicating with the Leasing Team about completion delays that might affect a resident’s move-in date

- Observing and ensuring job site safety during project management visits

- Negotiating terms of repairs with vendors and General Contractors based on company standards

- May be required to conduct occupancy checks and attend eviction lockouts/setouts in coordination with local law enforcement

- Performing other duties as assigned

Your Experience Includes
- High school diploma or equivalent

- OSHA 10 is required (new hires will have up to 90 days to complete OSHA 10 certification if not already certified)

- Minimum two years of project management experience managing multiple projects, budgets, timelines, and quality of work

- General knowledge of residential construction including plumbing, electrical, mechanical, HVAC, drywall, and flooring as well as local building codes

- Negotiating with and managing contractors to complete work

- Professional verbal and written communication skills

- Comfortability with using a tablet and general business applications (e.g. Outlook, Salesforce, etc.)

- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills

- Current driver’s license and automobile insurance

- Must provide basic hand and power tools 

- Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis including on weekends and non-traditional holidays if needed

- Extensive travel within assigned portfolio required

- Physical requirements include:
- Frequent climbing, reaching, use of fingers, stooping, kneeling, crawling, pushing, pulling, lifting, talking, and hearing

- Ability to lift and/or move an excess of 50 pounds or more and operate standard maintenance equipment as assigned

Why Us
We stand for flexibility, opportunity, and a home that people can make their own. It’s as true for our associates as it is for our residents. Just like we help our residents live freer, we liberate our associates’ careers, too. Our associates know that goals matter, potential is unlocked, and careers thrive. Invitation Homes isn’t just a workplace but a possibility place. We offer each new associate:
- Competitive pay and an annual bonus program for all associates

- Generous paid time off plans including vacation accrual, sick time, volunteer time, and standard and floating holidays

- 401k with matching company contributions

- Awesome work environment with casual dress

- Team events and gatherings

- Employee resource groups: Together with Women, Asian Alliance, Black Collective, Juntos, Gen Next, Valor, and Open Invitation.

Build a foundation here and apply today!

Salary Range
The salary range for this position is: $57,862.50 - $100,295.00, plus individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications, location, and applicable employment laws.

Compensation and Benefits
To attract and retain top talent, we're pleased to offer competitive compensation and benefits, including:
- Annual bonus program

- Health, dental, vision, and life insurance

- Long-term and short-term disability insurance

- Generous paid time off plans include vacation accrual, sick time, standard holidays and floating holidays

- 401(k) with company matching contributions

- Awesome work environment with casual dress

- Team events and gatherings (Pre- and Post-Covid)

Job Summary
Invitation Homes is pioneering a new industry and needs dedicated, innovative, and analytical technologists to help us continually optimize. As the nation’s premier home leasing company, we develop advanced technology to enhance the resident experience. We are looking for dynamic individuals who are passionate about taking tech to the next level. 

 

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager who can will lead an engineering team – someone who combines deep technical experience with great people management skills and can help elevate our teams and our approach to engineering. We are building a culture that fosters innovation, built on a foundation of inclusion and diversity. We are looking for a candidate that has proven experience in coding, architecture leadership, and leading engineers in a fast-paced environment. This position is a mix of hands-on-keyboard development, process engineering, and management responsibilities with a strong emphasis on technical leadership. 

 

You will be on the forefront of working on customer and employee facing applications as we build the next wave of technologies that will drive our resident experience to the next level. This is a chance to make a big impact on the people with whom you work day-to-day, as well as all the other stakeholders in our business. If you are motivated, passionate, a quick learner and have effective communication skills, this role is waiting for you! 

Invitation Homes does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities 

- Work closely with Product and Platform Owners, Quality Assurance, and other teams in an agile environment to build, deploy and maintain software systems 

- Design solutions with a focus on performance and maintainability 

- Measure and evaluate features and system metrics to continuously improve user experience and service performance 

- Grow and inspire a team of engineers through a combination of coaching, mentoring, feedback and career development 

- Cultivate a healthy, collaborative engineering culture that’s in line with our values.

- Document technical and integration architectures 

- Work collaboratively to help define and execute team roadmaps

- Experience working in agile development environment 

- Deep understanding of software and development engineering principles and concepts

- Experience working with distributed/scalable systems and high-volume transaction applications 

- Love of technology; actively seeks continuing education of current and emerging technologies 

 

Other Requirements 

- N/A 

 

Physical and Mental Demands 

This position will spend long hours sitting and using office equipment and computers. The position may also entail light lifting of supplies and materials occasionally, up to and including 20 pounds in addition to reaching, stooping, standing, and walking. The HOA Customer Service Representative serves as the primary liaison between residents, HOAs, and internal teams. This role ensures timely resolution of HOA-related issues, supports compliance processes, and delivers exceptional service through clear communication and proactive problem-solving.

The market teams include our Leasing and Property Management teams as well as our Rehab, Turns & Maintenance professionals.  Together, our talented teams create excellent resident experiences from the time the resident moves in to the home, throughout the duration of their lease and during their transition as they move out.  Our teams work hard to create and maintain high-quality homes and ensure potential residents are presented with a rental property they can’t refuse!   
We are seeking candidates with a drive to excel in our thriving organization.  We are looking for professionals who are ready to join our work-family, provide excellent service to internal and external customers and embrace our fast and friendly approach.  As the single-family home rental industry is quickly evolving, we are looking for dedicated learners who are passionate to serve our residents and maintain top-quality homes.  Apply today!  We’re looking forward to getting to know you! 

Job Summary

Job Summary

The Specialist of Asset Management is responsible for providing analytical and operational support on company-wide Asset Management programs and projects designed to strategically reinvest capital within the owned single-family rental (SFR) portfolio across 16 markets. Responsibilities include driving field-level capital program execution, leveraging advanced analytics and AI-assisted tools to optimize asset level NOI performance, and partnering closely with corporate and field teams as well as external investors and partners. The role requires demonstrated expertise in the residential single-family rental space, including familiarity with SFR market dynamics, asset lifecycle management, and data-driven disposition and reinvestment decision-making. This position will report to the Senior Manager, Asset Management.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

Capital Reinvestment & Field Execution
- Collaborate with operations teams and support other cross-functional business verticals to facilitate, execute, and expand capital reinvestment programs across all markets

- Track and report on capital deployment and program performance at both the individual asset and market level, partnering with field teams to ensure approved projects are executed on schedule and within budget

- Review and approve project proposals in compliance with established processes, workflows, and authority levels

- Support the development of market-level business plans, including renovation program ROI analysis, hold/sell recommendations, and market-specific reinvestment strategies

Analytics, Reporting & Decision-Making
- Develop and administer dashboards, analyses, and reports across all reporting cadences (ad-hoc as needed) using Tableau, Power BI, and other intelligence platforms

- Leverage internal dashboards, predictive analytics tools, and automated valuation models (AVMs) to identify portfolio performance outliers, forecast NOI and rent growth, and support disposition or reinvestment timing decisions

- Analyze data and identify trends and key findings in quantitative and qualitative data sets from the company’s internal Enterprise Data Warehouse, Yardi, Salesforce, Tableau, and other systems

- Support automation of reporting across internal software platforms and maintain financial and operational reporting dashboards and data visualizations

- Identify opportunities to design new and/or refine existing analyses and processes to improve the Asset Management team’s productivity, accuracy, and efficiency over time

- Utilize generative AI tools to accelerate data synthesis, reporting, and research tasks where appropriate

Financial Analysis & Portfolio Management
- Review, analyze, and recommend properties for disposition using hold/sell analysis frameworks including IRR, cap rate benchmarking, and market comparable methodologies; present recommendations to investment leadership for portfolio rebalancing decisions

- Support and enhance financial modeling and forecasting processes, including annual budget preparation in coordination with corporate departments

- Provide financial guidance to investment management leadership through preparation, review, and analysis of key financial metrics including NOI per asset, occupancy rates, rent growth, and return on capital

- Support ad-hoc analyses and projects as directed

Education and/or Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in finance, real estate, business, AI, economics, or a related field required; advanced degree (MS, MBA) is a plus

- 1-3 years of experience in financial/data analysis, investment analysis, institutional real estate, or SFR/BTR residential acquisitions or asset management is preferred; exceptional recent college graduates will be considered

- Prior experience in single-family rental, build-to-rent, or institutional residential real estate strongly preferred; familiarity with SFR market dynamics, per-home economics, and asset lifecycle management is a meaningful differentiator

- Financial modeling, business analytics, and/or other real estate experience required

- Working proficiency in Python, R, or SQL expected; advanced data science methods (regression, clustering, predictive modeling) are a strong plus

- Experience with data visualization in Tableau or Power BI preferred

- Comfort working with AI and machine learning outputs in a real estate or analytical context; experience with generative AI tools for reporting or data synthesis is a plus

Required Licenses or Certifications

- Current driver’s license and automobile insurance

Skills / Specialized Knowledge

Technical & Analytical
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) including advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, financial modeling) required; VBA a plus

- Working proficiency in Python or SQL for data querying, manipulation, and analysis; ability to build or maintain analytical models in a scripting environment

- Experience with BI and visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent); ability to build and maintain executive-ready dashboards

- Comfort interpreting automated valuation models, predictive maintenance schedules, or rent growth forecasts

- Familiarity with real estate and SFR-specific data platforms (Yardi, Salesforce, CoStar, JBREC, or similar) and cloud data environments (Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent) preferred

Real Estate & Business Acumen
- Understanding of SFR and institutional residential real estate fundamentals: cap rates, NOI, IRR, hold/sell analysis, disposition strategy, and asset lifecycle management

- Comfort with basic finance and accounting theory with the ability to read and comprehend financial statements

- Ability to translate complex data and financial analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership

Professional & Interpersonal
- Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability; comfortable operating autonomously in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

- Well-developed written and verbal communication skills with excellent interpersonal and organizational skills

- Ability to multi-task, maintain flexibility, set and meet goals, and consistently meet deadlines

- Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive business information

Other Requirements

- Some travel may be required to support field market visits and program reviews

- Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis; overtime may be required

- Authorization to work in the United States

Physical and Mental Demands

This position will spend long hours sitting and using office equipment and computers. The position may also entail light lifting of supplies and materials occasionally, up to and including 20 pounds in addition to reaching, stooping, standing, and walking. This position requires the ability to talk, hear, compare, compute, compile, copy, analyze, coordinate, synthesize, negotiate, and communicate. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

jobs.description:
Who We Are
Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together. Invitation Homes is a place where possibility lives.

The market teams include our Leasing, Property Management and Rehab, Turns & Maintenance professionals. Together, our dedicated associates work hard to build excellent resident experiences while maintaining high-quality homes and ensuring potential residents are presented with a rental property they can’t refuse.

Your Role on the Team
As a Superintendent at Invitation Homes you are responsible for full-cycle oversight of property rehab and turnover efforts. This includes but is not limited to the following tasks:
- Meeting with residents to complete Pre Move-Out Visits and documenting the home condition and resident responsibilities for a successful move-out.

- Meeting with incoming residents to complete Resident Orientations to welcome them, and educate them on the systems in their home as well as all important maintenance policies and procedures

- Conducting Move Out Inspections including a detailed inspection of the property and using our budgeting program to create a comprehensive scope of work and identify costs that should be charged back to the resident at move-out in accordance with company standards

- Overseeing all aspects of the rehab and turn process which includes communicating with contractors, submitting change orders, ensuring work is completed correctly and on schedule, and documenting the process with progress notes and “before” and “after” photos

- Communicating with the Leasing Team about completion delays that might affect a resident’s move-in date

- Observing and ensuring job site safety during project management visits

- Negotiating terms of repairs with vendors and General Contractors based on company standards

- May be required to conduct occupancy checks and attend eviction lockouts/setouts in coordination with local law enforcement

- Performing other duties as assigned

Your Experience Includes
- High school diploma or equivalent

- OSHA 10 is required (new hires will have up to 90 days to complete OSHA 10 certification if not already certified)

- Minimum two years of project management experience managing multiple projects, budgets, timelines, and quality of work

- General knowledge of residential construction including plumbing, electrical, mechanical, HVAC, drywall, and flooring as well as local building codes

- Negotiating with and managing contractors to complete work

- Professional verbal and written communication skills

- Comfortability with using a tablet and general business applications (e.g. Outlook, Salesforce, etc.)

- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills

- Current driver’s license and automobile insurance

- Must provide basic hand and power tools 

- Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis including on weekends and non-traditional holidays if needed

- Extensive travel within assigned portfolio required

- Physical requirements include:
- Frequent climbing, reaching, use of fingers, stooping, kneeling, crawling, pushing, pulling, lifting, talking, and hearing

- Generous paid time off plans including vacation accrual, sick time, volunteer time, and standard and floating holidays

- 401k with matching company contributions

- Awesome work environment with casual dress

- Team events and gatherings

- Employee resource groups: Together with Women, Asian Alliance, Black Collective, Juntos, Gen Next, Valor, and Open Invitation.

Build a foundation here and apply today!

The salary range for this position is: $57,862.50 - $100,295.00, plus individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications, location, and applicable employment laws.

Unlock the Power of You
At Invitation Homes, our associates are the foundation of our success. We connect your work to real impact, invest in your growth, and welcome you to feel at home — because care isn't just something we say, it's something you experience.

Who We Are

Invitation Homes owns and operates homes in great neighborhoods across 16 top U.S. markets. We continue to innovate with smart home technology, an industry-leading maintenance app, and other lifestyle-enhancing services that make leasing easier than owning.

Our market teams — Leasing, Property Management, and Rehab, Turns & Maintenance — work together to deliver excellent resident experiences and maintain high-quality homes. Every associate plays a meaningful role in that mission.

The Role

The Sr. Principal, Planning and Experience is a strategic advisor, integrator, and execution leader responsible for amplifying the impact of the EVP, Chief Experience Officer (MXG and Analytics) across the enterprise. This role acts as a key strategic partner to the EVP, ensuring alignment and operational excellence across all Experience functions — including Marketing, Customer Experience, Enterprise Analytics & Reporting, Product, Digital Experiences, and related cross‑functional initiatives.
This individual brings deep analytical fluency, translating data into actionable business decisions while bridging strategy with execution. The Sr. Principal partners closely with the Analytics and Reporting teams to equip the EVP and Experience organization with the insights, frameworks, and operating rhythms needed to accelerate growth, elevate customer experience, and scale impact.
This role also requires a unique blend of analytical storytelling and operational problem-solving, with the ability to quickly assess complex business challenges and translate insights into actionable, scalable solutions. The Sr. Principal brings a continuous improvement mindset, leveraging process optimization methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) to identify inefficiencies, recommend improvements, and drive measurable impact across the Experience organization and broader enterprise.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Advisory
- Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic thought partner to the EVP.
- Help shape and drive the Experience organization’s strategic agenda, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and cross‑functional alignment.
- Translate enterprise priorities into actionable roadmaps for Marketing, CX, Product, and Analytics teams.
- Prepare executive‑level insights, recommendations, and narratives for senior leadership and external stakeholders.
Analytics, Insights & Decision Enablement
- Partner with the Analytics & Reporting function to drive a unified insights ecosystem supporting EVP priorities.
- Translate analytical outputs into clear storylines and recommendations that influence executive decision-making and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
- Identify key trends, performance risks, and opportunities using customer, operational, financial, and digital product data; synthesize findings into actionable recommendations and business cases.
- Ensure reporting, dashboards, and measurement frameworks align to strategic objectives and OKRs.
Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence
- Apply continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma principles) to assess business processes, identify inefficiencies, and recommend scalable solutions.
- Rapidly diagnose challenges across functions and develop data-driven proposals to improve performance, efficiency, and customer outcomes.
- Partner with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements and track measurable impact.
- Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational rigor across the Experience organization.
Experience Organization Operations
- Drive the Experience organization’s operating cadence, including quarterly business reviews, strategic planning, goal setting, and performance management.
- Drive cross‑functional coordination across Marketing, CX, Product, and Ops to ensure consistent execution and collaboration.
- Help shape and implement standards, governance models, and feedback loops to ensure operational health and organizational clarity.
Program & Portfolio Execution
- Lead strategic programs and enterprise‑wide initiatives aligned with EVP priorities — particularly those requiring cross‑functional alignment or heavy analytical components, driving efficiency, scalability, and measurable business impact.
- Manage key customer experience transformation initiatives, ensuring measurable improvements in satisfaction, retention, and operational efficiency.
- Support resource allocation, budget tracking, and prioritization for major EVP‑sponsored programs and product investments.
- Operate as a flexible, high-impact problem solver who can be deployed across the business to assess ambiguous challenges, synthesize insights, and deliver actionable recommendations.
Communications & Stakeholder Engagement
- Develop executive communications, narratives, and presentations that reinforce EVP strategic priorities.
- Support the EVP in select executive meetings and cross-functional forums, driving continuity, alignment, and follow-through.
- Support change management efforts to ensure enterprise buy‑in and adoption of Experience‑driven initiatives.

Qualifications
Education & Experience
- 8-10+ years of progressive experience in Customer Experience, Marketing, Strategy, Analytics, Digital Product, or related fields.
- Experience leading or partnering closely with Analytics, Data, or BI teams required; proven ability to interpret complex datasets and drive insight‑based decision-making.
- Experience applying continuous improvement and operational excellence principles (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and drive measurable business outcomes.
- Experience operating in a matrixed environment, ideally within a high‑growth, multi‑market, or operationally complex organization.
- Previous experience in a Chief of Staff, strategy, transformation, or portfolio leadership role preferred.

Technical & Analytical Competencies
- Strong command of analytics, reporting, and data visualization frameworks.
- Ability to translate data into strategies, narratives, and business recommendations.
- Understanding of customer experience measurement (NPS/eNPS, VoC, journey analytics) and marketing/product performance metrics.

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies
- Highly strategic, intellectually curious, and comfortable operating in ambiguity.
- Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, including comfort with executive audiences.
- Strong relationship‑builder who can influence without authority and navigate complex organizational dynamics.
- Ability to coach and develop team members laterally, elevating thinking, problem-solving, and execution without direct reporting relationships.
- Skilled at engaging and collaborating with a wide range of personalities, from highly analytical to creative and operational partners.
- High degree of professionalism, confidentiality, and emotional intelligence.

Success Criteria (First 12 Months)
- Build a reputation as a trusted problem solver who can quickly assess challenges and deliver actionable, high-impact solutions
- Successfully demonstrate measurable improvements in operational efficiency and effectiveness through continuous improvement initiatives
- Establish a highly effective operating rhythm for the EVP and Experience organization.
- Strengthen the connection between Analytics and the Experience leadership team, improving insight quality and speed of decision‑making.
- Support the development and execution of an EVP strategic plan and measurement system that clarifies priorities and drives accountability.

Why Invitation Homes

We believe when our residents thrive, our associates thrive. Here, you're not just filling a role — you're building a career at a company that invests in your growth and welcomes you for who you are.

jobs.summary: Who We Are Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together.
jobs.description:

Invitation Homes is a team of more than 1,700 associates who come from all walks of life. We call different communities “home," but our shared values bind us together. Invitation Homes is a place where possibility lives.
The market teams include our Leasing, Property Management and Rehab, Turn & Maintenance professionals. Together, our dedicated associates work hard to build excellent resident experiences while maintaining high-quality homes and ensuring potential residents are presented with a rental property they can’t refuse.

Your Role on the Team

As a Maintenance Technician II at Invitation Homes, you will be performing high-quality maintenance work in our single-family rental homes while providing outstanding customer service to our residents. This includes but is not limited to the following tasks:
- Completing maintenance service requests across multiple trades

- Providing excellent customer service and promoting a quality living experience for all residents

- Perform required work while demonstrating respect for resident’s home

- Completing regular ProCare visits in residents’ homes to perform proactive maintenance and repairs
- Complete the associated checklist for each visit within its respective mobile app platform.

- At the completion of the visit, schedule the next ProCare Maintenance Visit with the resident through the maintenance mobile app

- Educating residents regarding all maintenance topics by specifically showing webpage of Invitation Homes expectations. (https://www.invitationhomes.com/resident-responsibilities)

- Educating residents on the functional systems of their rental home

- Completing general property condition assessments at all property visits and alerting the property management team when items require immediate attention

- Reviewing and using Technician-specific reports to find opportunities for improvement

- Performing repairs in vacant properties while they are on-the-market or during the turn process

- Properly using and caring for company-supplied tools, materials, and vehicles

- On a daily basis, proactively review the next day’s appointments to ensure the proper equipment, material, information, and allotted time is available to complete the work in a single visit

- Adhere to all Invitation Homes safety guidelines

- Performing other duties as assigned

Your Experience Includes
- High School diploma or equivalent

- 2-5 years’ proven experience in residential repairs and maintenance, other building maintenance or related experience

- OSHA 10 is required (new hires will have up to 90 days to complete OSHA 10 certification if not already certified) 

- The following certifications are a plus:
- EPA Certification: Type I, Type II, and/or EPA Universal

- HVAC Certification

- CPO certification (pool)

- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills as well as strong verbal and written communication skills; multi-lingual is a plus

- Comfortability using mobile devices (i.e. iPad and/or iPhone) and various mobile applications

- Understanding of residential construction and mechanical systems and ability to perform general repairs in some of the following: plumbing, electrical, carpentry, sheetrock, exterior structural, HVAC (minor) and appliances. Some training will be provided.

- Must possess a current driver's license, automobile insurance, and any other licenses and/or certification as required by state law

- Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis including weekends and holidays as needed

- Ability to provide basic hand and power tools

- Ability to perform work that requires the following:
- Frequent climbing, reaching, use of fingers, stooping, kneeling, crawling, pushing, pulling, lifting, talking, and hearing

- Ability to lift and/or move an excess of 50 pounds or more and operate standard maintenance equipment as assigned

Why Us

We stand for flexibility, opportunity, and a home that people can make their own. It’s as true for our associates as it is for our residents. Just like we help our residents live freer, we liberate our associates’ careers, too. Our associates know that goals matter, potential is unlocked, and careers thrive. - Competitive pay and an annual bonus program for all associates

- Employee resource groups: Together with Women, Asian Alliance, The Black Collective, Juntos, Gen Next, Valor, and Open Invitation

The salary range for this position is: $20.19 - $35.00, plus individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications, location, and applicable employment laws.

Compensation and Benefits
To attract and retain top talent, we're pleased to offer competitive compensation and benefits, including:

jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Analyst, CAM drives day-to-day asset management across the Build-to-Rent (BTR) community portfolio. This role bridges operational execution and data-driven strategy — owning performance reporting, managing cross-functional partnerships, and implementing process improvements that lift occupancy, NOI, and resident satisfaction. The associate takes on direct accountability for strategy identification and implementation, KPI tracking, forecasting, and portfolio-level coordination while building toward future leadership responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

Asset Performance & Reporting
- Own community-level performance reporting: build and maintain dashboards in Power BI/Tableau/Claude tracking occupancy, leasing velocity, maintenance costs, and resident satisfaction
- Produce weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports for market and corporate leadership, translating data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations
- Support portfolio-level reviews to identify underperforming assets; track corrective action plans
- Analyze data and identify trends and key findings in both qualitative and quantitative data sets from various systems
- Conduct variance analysis on budgets, forecasts, and capital expenditures; surface anomalies and proposed resolutions
- Maintain and continuously improve data integrity across Yardi, Salesforce, and all reporting portals
- Support community-specific asset management strategies to maximize occupancy, NOI, and resident retention
- Serve as the central liaison between corporate Asset Management and on-site teams, marketing, maintenance, leasing, and technology
- Conduct regular market and community audits to ensure alignment with asset performance goals and brand standards
- Identify operational inefficiencies and lead process improvement initiatives across the portfolio
- Assist in oversight of special projects related to community enhancements, capital improvements, and operational scaling
- Champion resident engagement programs and community events to maintain high satisfaction scores and low turnover
- Analyze resident satisfaction data and maintenance trends; recommend proactive measures to improve retention
- Evaluate vendor performance using data-driven scorecards; escalate issues as needed
- Assist in annual budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning exercises
- Monitor actuals vs. budget using advanced Excel financial models; flag risks and opportunities early
- Identify opportunities to design new and/or refine existing analyses and processes to improve the asset management team’s productivity, accuracy, and efficiency over time

Qualifications

Education and/or Experience
- Bachelor’s degree and strong academic record in Finance, Economics, Quantitative Analytics, or related fields required
- 2+ years analytical support roles, in property management, asset management, or multifamily/BTR operations
- Demonstrated familiarity with Single-Family Rental (SFR) or Build-to-Rent communities and new home building processes
- Experience creating investment and portfolio presentations for Senior leadership a plus
- Strong experience working with large data sets and performing exploratory data analysis required

Technical Skills
- Advanced proficiency in Power BI or Tableau — ability to build and maintain executive-level dashboards
- Experience with Python, R, Capital IQ, John Burns, Salesforce, and Yardi a plus
- Expert-level Excel: pivot tables, financial modeling, variance analysis, and data visualization
- Hands-on experience with Yardi and/or RealPage, including reporting and operational modules
- Working knowledge of Salesforce or equivalent CRM for resident and partner relationship tracking
- High comfort adopting and evaluating new technologies; genuine curiosity for tech-enabled workflows

Analytical & Reporting Skills
- Strong ability to synthesize large data sets into concise reports with actionable insights
- Proven track record building performance dashboards and presenting findings to senior leadership
- Experience tracking KPIs including occupancy rates, leasing velocity, NPS, maintenance response times, and NOI drivers

- Excellent project management and organizational skills with a strong sense of urgency
- Superior written and verbal communication; able to translate complex data into plain business language
- Proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, independently or collaboratively

- Adaptable and solution-oriented with a growth mindset
- Ability to manage multiple competing priorities and deadlines

- Completing maintenance service requests across multiple trades
- Providing excellent customer service and promoting a quality living experience for all residents
- Perform required work while demonstrating respect for resident’s home
- Completing regular ProCare visits in residents’ homes to perform proactive maintenance and repairs- Complete the associated checklist for each visit within its respective mobile app platform.
- At the completion of the visit, schedule the next ProCare Maintenance Visit with the resident through the maintenance mobile app

- Educating residents regarding all maintenance topics by specifically showing webpage of Invitation Homes expectations. (https://www.invitationhomes.com/resident-responsibilities)

- Reviewing and using Technician-specific reports to find opportunities for improvement
- Performing repairs in vacant properties while they are on-the-market or during the turn process
- Properly using and caring for company-supplied tools, materials, and vehicles

- CPO certification (pool)

- Ability to provide basic hand and power tools
- Ability to perform work that requires the following:- Frequent climbing, reaching, use of fingers, stooping, kneeling, crawling, pushing, pulling, lifting, talking, and hearing

jobs.description:
What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it’s going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

About the Role

The Senior Manager, Construction is responsible for leading Roofstock's Construction organization, overseeing the execution of renovation, turn, and capital improvement programs across multiple markets. This leader is accountable for operational performance, team development, vendor strategy, and continuous process improvement while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on budget, on schedule, and in accordance with Roofstock quality standards.

Leading a team of Construction Specialists and Senior Construction Specialists, the Senior Manager establishes the operating rhythm through scalable processes, data-driven decision making, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Success in this role is measured not only by project outcomes, but by the organization's ability to consistently deliver exceptional customer experiences while improving cost, speed, and quality at scale.

This leader partners closely with Product, Property Management, Field Operations, Vendor Management, Asset Management, and People Operations to modernize construction operations through automation and AI-enabled workflows. The Senior Manager serves as the voice of Construction, helping define future operating models, shape product roadmaps, and translate technology investments into measurable operational improvements.

The ideal candidate combines deep residential construction expertise with exceptional operational leadership, analytical thinking, and people management experience. They are equally comfortable coaching leaders, negotiating with strategic vendors, reviewing portfolio analytics, and representing Construction in executive and customer-facing discussions.

Success in this Role

Within your first year, you will:

- Build a high-performing Construction organization that consistently delivers predictable project outcomes across all supported markets.

- Improve cycle time, quality, and cost performance through standardized processes and data-driven decision making.

- Develop future leaders while creating scalable processes that support continued business growth.

- Partner across the organization to implement technology and AI-enabled workflows that improve efficiency and customer experience.

- Serve as the trusted operational leader for Construction, balancing executional excellence with long-term organizational strategy.

Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Construction Specialists and Senior Construction Specialists, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

- Own the operational performance of the Construction organization, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with Roofstock quality standards.

- Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including turn cycle time, budget adherence, quality, customer satisfaction, contractor performance, and team productivity.

- Drive operational excellence by developing standardized processes, playbooks, and quality controls that improve consistency and scalability across all markets.

- Partner with Vendor Management to build and maintain a high-performing contractor network, including vendor onboarding, performance management, capacity planning, and strategic sourcing initiatives.

- Travel regularly to supported markets to inspect properties, validate quality standards, strengthen vendor relationships, and identify opportunities to improve operational performance.

- Lead workforce planning efforts by aligning staffing, capacity, and market coverage with projected business demand while supporting organizational growth.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Property Management, Field Operations, Asset Management, Product, Finance, and People Operations to improve the end-to-end renovation experience for residents, owners, and internal stakeholders.

- Champion AI, automation, and technology-enabled workflows by partnering with Product and Engineering to identify system enhancements, shape roadmap priorities, and improve operational scalability.

- Analyze operational and financial performance to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, cost, quality, and customer outcomes.

- Manage escalated construction issues, balancing customer experience, financial stewardship, and operational priorities while driving timely resolution.

- Develop and manage departmental budgets, forecasting labor, contractor, and operational expenses while identifying opportunities to improve financial performance.

- Build organizational capability through hiring, onboarding, coaching, succession planning, and leadership development, creating a strong pipeline of future leaders.

- Represent the Construction organization in executive business reviews, strategic planning initiatives, and cross-functional programs that support company objectives.

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in residential construction, renovations, property maintenance, or a related field, with progressively increasing leadership responsibility.

- 5+ years leading managers, supervisors, or high-performing operational teams in a multi-market environment.

- Demonstrated success leading multi-market operations with accountability for quality, budget, service levels, and execution.

- Strong understanding of residential construction practices, estimating, scopes of work, contractor management, and project lifecycle management.

- Experience developing operational processes, driving change management, and leading continuous improvement initiatives.

- Strong analytical skills with experience using operational metrics and data to make business decisions.

- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional partners and executive leadership.

- Experience managing departmental budgets, operational planning, and resource allocation.

- Proven ability to develop leaders, build high-performing teams, and create a culture of accountability and engagement.

Location

This role must be located in Dallas, TX

Compensation

$115,000 - $140,000 annually

Compensation range may be adjusted based on experience and location.

Pay Transparency

Our compensation reflects several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position represents the expected salary for this position. Ultimately, in determining your pay it will be based on several factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience and other job related factors. Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only a part of our total compensation package.

Competitive & Unique Benefits Package

- Generous PTO Policy

- 12 Paid Holidays

- Volunteer Time Off

- Paid Parental Leave

- 401k Program

- Wellness and home office/cell phone subsidies

- Robust health, dental, vision insurance, and more

- Wellness and home office/cell phone subsidies

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment and we are unable to sponsor H1-B Visas at this time.

Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation.

Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Roofstock is an equal opportunity employer. In keeping with the values of Roofstock, we make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

jobs.summary: About the Company There are 17 million Americans who own rental property. Most don't want to be landlords anymore, but selling isn’t a good option.
jobs.description:
About the Company

There are 17 million Americans who own rental property. Most don't want to be landlords anymore, but selling isn’t a good option. Why? You’d lose income and appreciation, trigger tax liabilities, kick out your tenants, have to fix up the house – the list goes on! Flock is here to help.

Flock’s mission is to provide every retiring landlord with the most cost-efficient and seamless exit. Our first product is a tech-enabled 721 Exchange for residential landlords. Owners contribute properties into our professionally managed Fund, in exchange for passive equity ownership. It's a direct 721 Exchange model designed for everyday owners who want access to continued cashflows, liquidity, and diversification without triggering capital gains, disturbing tenants, or dealing with disposition friction. We’re growing fast and are looking for smart, entrepreneurial hustlers who want to help build something category-defining.

We’re backed by top tier investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Primary Ventures, Renegade Partners, SUSA Ventures, 1Sharpe Ventures, and leaders from Invitation Homes and Opendoor.

About the Role

Flock is hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our small, high-impact product team. We’re building a 10x version of Flock from the ground up, redefining how mom-and-pops invest in real estate.

This is a generalist role by design, with autonomy over what you build. You'll work across the entire stack and customer journey – frontend, backend, data, infra, and AI – picking up whatever a project needs rather than owning a single layer. Most of our work is growth engineering: driving quality leads and building the tools, automations, and AI-powered products that compound our funnel. You'll ship fast, measure everything, and make choices based on data (not roadmaps handed down from above).

What You’ll Do:

- Build across the stack: Design, ship, and iterate on the platforms and tools that power Flock's Exchange and Fund — from acquisition to fund operations to the investor experience.

- Own features end-to-end: Take features from MVP to production, working directly with Design and Ops to iterate and move fast.

- Shape the roadmap: Influence major product and engineering decisions. This is a small team where your input materially changes what gets built.

- Build for the whole company: Develop tools that make Acquisitions, Operations, and Asset Management faster and sharper, not just customer-facing features.

- Set the engineering bar: Help establish the processes, code standards, and culture that let engineering scale as Flock grows.

- Empower the team: Everyone at Flock has the power to build - non-engineers included. You’ll build the tooling that makes this possible through developing AI infrastructure that brings everyone’s ideas to life.

About You:

- 2-5 years experience building and delivering production quality software systems. Strong candidates are expected to operate independently.

- Eager to Grow: Learns unfamiliar areas fast, and leans on AI to move into them quickly.

- Full-Stack Fluency: We use TypeScript, React, Node, GraphQL/Apollo, Go, Python, AWS (ECS/Beanstalk), and Salesforce (but we care more about range and speed than any specific tool).

- AI-forward: Comfortable building with AI tools and agents—this is central to how we work.

- Collaborative: You default to an iterative approach to problem solving and work well with Product, Design, and non-technical teams across Sales, Ops, and Asset Management.

- Bias to Action: You'd rather ship and iterate than wait for a perfect spec.

- Metrics-driven: Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a proven track record of using data to measure success and inform decisions.

- Organized: Able to balance multiple projects and prioritize competing tasks.

- Ethical: Conduct business with the highest level of integrity and professionalism.

Must be excited to work in-person 5 days/week.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we recommend applying to the role!

Note: This is a full-time, in-person role.

The target annual salary for this role is $156-204k OTE, plus equity and benefits (medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k, and unlimited PTO).
