jobs.description:
Are you a strategic builder who loves turning local insights into national momentum? TurboTenant is looking for a Director of Local Marketing to architect, own, and scale our go-to-market local playbook from a handful of key regions into a powerhouse national footprint. This isn’t just about buying billboards or managing budgets; it’s about taking complete ownership of how TurboTenant shows up in physical and digital communities across the country.

In this role, you’ll serve as the decision-maker for our local growth strategy, balancing out-of-home media, local SEO, community partnerships, and demand generation. You will partner fluidly across Product Marketing, Sales, Performance, and Escalations to build repeatable systems that accelerate market profitability and solidify TurboTenant as the premier property management platform in every neighborhood we touch.

Key Responsibilities:

- ROI-Driven Market Strategy: Every market you invest in hits its profitability targets faster because you've prioritized capital based on unit economics, sales capacity, and vendor supply — and you pull budget out of underperforming markets before it becomes a drag on the portfolio.

- Out-of-Home & Local Media: Local media spend consistently converts into pipeline, and every new market launches on a proven channel mix playbook instead of starting from scratch — cutting the time and guesswork it takes to find what works in a new region.

- Lead Generation & Conversion Optimization: Local lead sources are tuned to sales outcomes, not just volume — bid strategies shift in response to real conversion data, so spend keeps flowing toward the sources that actually close.

- Local SEO & Reputation Mastery: TurboTenant shows up first in local search across your markets, and customer sentiment trends positive — you and Escalations have turned review management into a growth lever instead of a defense.

- Community & Strategic Partnerships: Local sponsorships, events, and partnerships consistently build credibility with DIY landlords and property managers, because you've set clear deal criteria that keep every partnership tied to measurable brand or pipeline impact.

- Operational Precision: Every market goes live on day one fully compliant and fully operational — signage, PO boxes, and logistics are never the reason a launch slips.

- AI-Driven Market Expansion: As a result of AI tooling to inform market evaluation and planning, each launch gets faster and more effective. Tooling is shared, and team members are trained to make an impact on the entire org outside of just Local Marketing.

- Team Leadership & Scale: Your local marketing team scales ahead of the business's expansion plans, staffed with people who operate with urgency and an owner's mindset — and the team gets stronger, not thinner, as it grows.

Qualifications:

Required:

- 6+ years of marketing experience, including significant experience owning go-to-market strategy end-to-end

- 3+ years of experience setting strategy for local or out-of-home marketing (billboards, print, radio, or similar channels), not just executing within it

- 3+ years of experience managing budgets, with the ability to use operating costs and unit economics (CAC, LTV) to guide market-level investment decisions

- Experience hiring, coaching, and managing a team, with a track record of building high-performing teams

- Comfortable managing multiple vendor relationships and coordinating operational logistics, with strong reporting and data skills to track and communicate performance to leadership

Strongly preferred:

- 3+ years of experience partnering with or directly informing SEO strategy

- 3+ years of experience managing paid lead sources, bids, or performance-based marketing spend

- 2+ years of experience setting partnership, sponsorship, or event strategy — including defining deal criteria and investment levels

- Experience in the service industry, including working closely with call centers or sales teams to align marketing lead quality with conversion and revenue outcomes

Nice-to-have:

- Experience with brand reputation, review management, or customer escalations

- Negotiation experience

- Experience using tools such as Google Analytics, HubSpot, local SEO tools, and other data reporting platforms

Location & Connection:

Our Marketing team is based in Denver, Colorado. We believe in-person connection is essential to our culture, which is why this role follows a hybrid schedule. You will be expected in the office at least three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday).

About Us:

At TurboTenant, we simplify the complex and intimidating process of managing your own rental property. And we do it through an elegant software platform for small, “do-it-yourself” landlords and their tenants. But don’t take our word for it—Read reviews from some of our 1 million landlords!

Our Be Better Culture:

At TurboTenant, we live by the Be Better mantra. Our high-performance culture makes us relentless in our efforts to Be Better at serving our landlords and renters, and in unlocking the potential in one another.

What does our Be Better culture mean to you?

- You’ll be in an environment that pushes you to reach your potential.

- You’ll make a massive impact on our landlords, renters, company, and the proptech industry.

- You’ll be on the highest performing team of your career.

We're Proud to Offer:

- Competitive compensation package

- 22 days of PTO during the first year, increasing with tenure

- Annual bonus based on company performance

- Equity – an owner’s mindset is a big part of being a member of the TurboTeam

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans – with multiple plans covered at 100%

- 9 paid holidays per year + a paid day off for your birthday

- 401k Matching

- Annual bike tune-up reimbursement

Compensation: $160,000 - $170,000 + equity. The actual compensation offered will be based on experience.

Salary Range
$160,000—$170,000 USD

Additional Information

TurboTenant is proud to serve a diverse group of landlords and renters. We strive to reflect that diversity within our team. Employment at TurboTenant is based on merit, competence, performance, and business need. TurboTenant celebrates being an equal opportunity employer and never discriminates based on race, color, genetic information, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), age, or any other basis protected by law.

At this time, employer-based visa sponsorship is not available. All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Next Steps

Ready to work on the highest performing team of your career at TurboTenant? Submit your resume and we’ll be in touch soon.

jobs.description:
Kiavi is one of the nation’s largest private lenders to residential real estate investors (REIs). We harness the power of data & technology to offer our customers a simpler, more reliable, and faster way to access the capital they need to scale their businesses.

Formerly known as LendingHome, we’re committed to helping REIs revitalize the approximately $25 trillion worth of aged U.S. housing stock to provide move-in ready homes and rental housing for millions of Americans across the country.

Combining our technology and industry expertise, Kiavi has grown to a team of over 500 and has won many awards over the years including Forbes Fintech 50, Finovate Awards, Best Digital Mortgage Platform, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and many more.

- Loans Funded: $30 billion in loans funded

- Homes financed: 100,000+ projects funded for our customers across the country

- Geography: 49 states + D.C. where we lend to REIs so they can revitalize neighborhoods

- Employees: Over 500 employees with competitive benefits and perks

This position can be based remotely in any of our approved hiring regions. Our hybrid distributed workforce philosophy allows us to find the best talent in the country and build diverse teams, while allowing our colleagues to work from the location that works best for them.

Identity Verification Notice: To ensure the security and integrity of our hiring process, all candidates are required to complete a secure identity verification. This process uses biometric and device validation to confirm identity and liveness. All data is handled securely in accordance with our privacy policy.

The Role

Kiavi Servicing Team is the primary point of contact for our customers after a loan is approved. Our goal is to provide the best mortgage experience for our customers and keep them coming back. The Customer Care Specialist role completes all transactions associated with loan activity, including monthly payments, loan modifications, refinances, and payoffs. The Customer Care Specialist role is also the first point of contact for customers and handles/resolves any incoming inquiries and requests.

Responsibilities

- Resolves incoming customer-inquiries and requests related to mortgage loans

- Reach out to borrowers to resolve any issues with payments and payment accounts

- Work with other servicing teams to identify borrowers who are at risk of default and determine best approach

- Document all customer interaction in Kiavi’s system of record

- Process payoff and verification of mortgage

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree

- Build relationships and work closely in a team environment

- Ability to understand customer issues and own any issue through resolution

- Knowledge of Excel or spreadsheet equivalent experience, Microsoft Office

- Knowledge of TCPA, FDCPA and Mortgage related CFPB guidelines preferred

- Knowledge of Tax, Escrow Analysis, Mortgage Insurance and Hazard Insurance is a plus

- Experience with Salesforce or related platform is a plus

Kiavi takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. The expected annualized base pay range for this full-time role to be performed remotely is $40,000 to $60,000 + $3,000 bonus + benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Your recruiter can share more about the specific base pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the pay range listed above reflects the base salary only, and does not include the target value of bonus or benefits.

Benefits and Perks

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Kiavi offers free employee-only coverage for medical, dental, and vision plans. Dependents receive a heavily discounted premium, competitively placed in the 90th percentile for cost.

- Health Savings Account (HSA): For those enrolled in a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Kiavi provides an annual employer contribution to HSAs: $1,000 for individual coverage and $2,000 for dependents.

- Disability and Life Insurance: Immediate access to short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as group life and AD&D insurance, with coverage at 1x annual salary.

- Remote Work Policy: Kiavi supports working remotely for day to day activities for most roles and occasionally may ask employees to gather in person for key meetings, training, team building etc. For remote workers, Kiavi offers a one-time office setup reimbursement of up to $500 and a monthly $85 stipend for internet and phone expenses. For in-office workers, Kiavi offers employer contributions to commuter benefits account, either for parking or public transportation.

- Flexible Time Off: Employees are empowered to manage their own time off, with no strict limits, as long as it's approved by their manager.

- Paid Leaves: Up to 8 weeks of paid leave for medical or caregiver purposes, and 12 weeks of paid maternity/paternity leave. Short-term disability leave is also available for birthing mothers.

- 401(k) & Company Match: A 401(k) plan managed by Fidelity, with Kiavi matching 100% of contributions up to 3% of compensation or $8,000 (whichever is less). All employer contributions are immediately vested.

Protect yourself from recruitment scams:

- If you are offered an interview or a role with Kiavi, this will be communicated with you through email, via an official email address ending in @kiavi.com or @lendinghome.com.

- You will never be asked for payments of any kind during the process.

- We also never communicate with candidates via Whatsapp at any point during the recruitment process.

- We won’t ask for personal information or data via text message. If you have any concerns regarding how genuine a text message is, please contact your recruiter.

- You can find our official Kiavi careers page here. We advise you to check that the page details and website addresses match if you have any concerns.

jobs.title: Owner Experience Manager
jobs.summary: About Pacaso Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people.
jobs.description:
About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

- No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking

- Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)

- Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation

- Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)

- Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)

- LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

The Owner Experience Manager is the primary lifecycle owner for Pacaso owners within a defined region, responsible for driving satisfaction, engagement, retention, and value realization across their portfolio.

Operating as a strategic account manager, this role serves as the consistent, relationship-driven point of contact throughout the ownership journey — from post-sale onboarding through active ownership, optimization, and resale advisory.

By developing deep familiarity with their regional homes and owners, the Owner Experience Manager builds trusted relationships, anticipates risk, and protects long-term retention and brand integrity.

Core Responsibilities

Regional Portfolio & Lifecycle Ownership

- Manage a defined portfolio of owners within a specific region

- Serve as the primary relationship owner and strategic point of contact

- Own the transition of new owners from Sales into the regional portfolio

- Guide onboarding, first-stay milestones, and expectation setting

- Develop deep knowledge of regional homes, owner preferences, usage patterns, and sentiment

- Act as the internal advocate for assigned owners across the organization

Engagement, Utilization & Retention Strategy

- Monitor engagement, utilization, and owner health across the regional portfolio

- Proactively intervene when risk indicators emerge (declining usage, negative feedback, low engagement)

- Lead consultative retention conversations focused on long-term value realization

- Advise owners on calendar strategy and usage optimization based on demand trends and availability patterns

- Identify friction points early and coordinate cross-functional solutions to protect loyalty and satisfaction

Resale Advisory & Transaction Coordination

- Serve as the primary advisor for owners considering resale within the region

- Conduct retention-focused discovery while providing informed guidance on resale timing and expectations

- Advise on share pricing in partnership with Sales/Acquisitions

- Partner with Sales/Marketing to prepare listings and align on transition strategy

- Coordinate resale workflows, documentation, and contract execution processes

- Partner with Sales to maintain proactive communication throughout the transaction to ensure a seamless and positive transition

- Protect owner sentiment and brand integrity through offboarding

Cross-Functional & Tier Partnership

- Partner closely with Owner Experience Agents (first line of defense for owner inquiries) to ensure seamless escalation, communication continuity, and relationship alignment

- Provide strategic context and guidance to support issue resolution and protect owner sentiment

- Collaborate with Asset Management, Sales, and Accounting to align communication and execution across the ownership journey

- Maintain accountability for owner outcomes even when issues are escalated or executed by other teams

Ideal Background

- 5+ years in luxury hospitality, high-end real estate, private membership, or premium client services

- Lives within driving distance of Park City

- Experience managing high-value client relationships across a full lifecycle

- Strong consultative, retention, and conflict-resolution skills

- Working knowledge of real estate pricing dynamics and transaction processes

We combine proprietary technology, licensed property tax professionals, and deep market expertise to lower what real estate owners pay in property taxes. From single-family rental landlords to institutional REITs, our platform provides assessment monitoring, property tax appeals, and strategic advisory services.

Our Culture

People are our superpower! Centered in everything we do is a true sense of team. We listen and we learn from each other. We are on this rocketship together and embrace a fast-paced, truly collaborative environment. We are here to win as a team and as a company.

You'll bring deep real estate fluency to the role, but you'll also operate the way a fast-growing tech company does - data-driven, fast-moving, and closely connected to how the product itself evolves.

What You'll Do:

- Build real trust with asset managers, CFOs, and owner-operators by understanding their portfolio strategy and what's actually driving their decisions, not just their case file

- Own appeal strategy for your accounts at the county level. Know when to push, when to settle, and how to explain the why to an owner who wants more than a form letter

- Deliver results with real candor, good or bad. Flag the properties that need a second look before they turn into a bigger problem

- Look for ways to expand the relationship: a new entity, a new market, a bigger ask. Go after them instead of waiting for renewal season

- A natural ability to earn trust with high-net-worth individuals, and to hold your own with C-suite executives and other senior decision-makers

As a Hospitality Coordinator, you're the on-the-ground expert keeping our short-term rental homes functional, clean, and stocked for every guest. Your work directly shapes guest satisfaction, review scores, and the care of our homeowners' properties.

The Details:

What we do and why we do it

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

How it’s going (and growing)

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of Stessa (financial and asset management software), RentPrep (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and Mynd (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in Casago (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

Roofstock’s Values → Short-Term Rental (STR) Org Reflection

- We are entrepreneurs → Launch a startup within a startup

- We are better together → Work across functions & business units to do it fast and well

- We focus on impact → Build a profitable business unit with satisfied owners, teammates, and guests

- We think like investors → Enhance owners’ and Roofstock’s ROI

About the Team

Roofstock’s STR team has the opportunity to build and shape an entirely new business unit together. The team is obsessed with people, in particular our owners, our guests, and our teammates. We extend our hospitality to everyone around us, there’s no such thing as “not my job,” and we celebrate our wins together. We plan to expand within our current markets as well as to roll out new markets in the years to come. Much like a startup business, things are fast-paced, intense, and exhilarating. And when the team wins, we all win.

About the Role

As a Hospitality Coordinator, you’ll serve as the on-the-ground expert responsible for keeping our homes functional, clean, and stocked (FCS) for every guest. You’ll perform inspections, restock supplies, prep for arrivals, complete light maintenance, and respond to in-market issues during and between stays.

This role is a combination of what many companies call a property caretaker and a runner and may at times include work more generally associated with that of a hotel front desk. You’ll be field-based, covering a subset of homes in your zone, and will report to the Team Lead, Hospitality Ops. Your work will directly impact guest satisfaction, review scores, and how well we care for our homeowners’ properties.

Responsibilities

- Conduct inspections of homes before and after guest stays to ensure they meet brand standards; document inspections and reports issues via our task management systems

- Restock consumables and inventory supplies to maintain FCS readiness

- Leave hospitality touches such as gifts and welcome notes for arriving guests

- Handle basic maintenance tasks (e.g., lightbulb changes, TV resets, small repairs) and coordinate with the Maintenance team for larger issues

- Support turnovers with tasks like bedmaking, resetting decor, tidying, and removing trash

- Respond quickly to urgent in-stay needs or on-the-ground guest issues when dispatched

- Track supply usage and flag homes with unusual patterns or repeated problems

- Be a visible, professional presence in the field, supporting teammates and guests as needed including occasionally taking incoming phone calls/messages and making outbound calls/messages to guests and owners

- Support Hospitality Managers with dispatching of field tasks during non-peak times of day

- Primarily support the operations of your zone while being available to assist other zones as needed based on market need

Success Measures

- Guest satisfaction and review scores (portfolio average above 4.8)

- Number of inspections completed per shift/day

- Completion rate and accuracy for assigned tasks

- Responsiveness to urgent or in-stay issues

- Homes consistently meeting FCS standards as verified by market leadership

Qualifications

- Detail-oriented and highly reliable

- Ability to follow checklists and brand standards consistently

- Physically capable of lifting 25+ lbs and walking/standing throughout the day

Work Environment and Physical Demands

- Availability to frequently work weekends, holidays, early mornings, and evenings (with 2 days off each week)

Pay Transparency

Our compensation reflects several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position represents the expected salary for this position. Ultimately, in determining your pay it will be based on several factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience and other job related factors. Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only a part of our total compensation package.

jobs.description:
About Lineage

Lineage is the platform for rental property investors. We coordinate acquisition, lending, insurance, and property management into a single transaction so investors can buy rental property as simply as they buy stocks. Our mission is to open real estate investing to everyone. The founding team has completed $1.5B+ in transactions and served 6,000+ investors. The platform is new. The experience behind it is not.

We're seed-stage and have product-market fit. The hardest problems are ahead. We hire fewer, more senior people and let AI multiply their output. Every hire changes what the company becomes.

The role

You're the first conversation an investor has with Lineage, and your job is to turn interest into a booked meeting. You qualify inbound leads, get the ones who fit onto an Investment Plan Consultation with an account executive, and then make sure they actually show up. You won't pitch the platform, talk properties, or cold-call strangers. These are people who already raised their hand, and your job is to get them onto the calendar and glad they said yes.

We move quickly with little process overhead, and because your texts and calls set the tone for everything that follows, they need to be warm, clear, and easy to say yes to. You'll join a small, distributed team and report to Brendan Seiber, Director of Sales. The role is remote.

The number that matters most in this seat is show rate, because a booked meeting that doesn't hold is worth nothing. It's the highest-leverage lever in the whole funnel, and moving it is your job.

This is a setter seat, not a closing seat. It's also where our account executives learn the funnel from the ground up. Prove you can qualify cleanly and hold a calendar, and the path to an AE seat is open. We'd rather promote a strong setter than hire a stranger to close.

Work you'll do

In your first 90 days you'll own the top of our direct-to-consumer funnel, qualifying inbound leads and getting them booked and held.

- Run the quick qualification call, usually about five minutes. Confirm the two things that matter, $100K+ in liquid capital and an openness to buying out of state, then book the Investment Plan Consultation within three days. It isn't a sales call, so there's no pitching or property talk.

- Reach new leads fast. A fresh hand-raiser gets a first touch within 15 minutes, because speed to lead is most of the game.

- Hand the investor off to the account executive at booking and introduce them by name, so the person feels committed to a human rather than a slot on a calendar.

- Run the confirmation cadence over text and email, at booking, the day before, the morning of, and 30 minutes before, so the meeting holds.

- Log everything in HubSpot the moment it happens, not at the end of the day. If it isn't in the CRM, it didn't happen.

What we're looking for

We hire for optimism, agency, and rigor, and we screen hard for self-awareness.

Specific to this role:

- You're outgoing, friendly, and easy to like on the phone. People enjoy talking to you, and you can make a stranger want to meet with us in the space of a short call.

- You're organized and quick, and a fast pace energizes you instead of rattling you.

- You can qualify without pitching, and you know the difference between booking a good fit and booking a warm body.

- You're persistent without being pushy. You get people to show up through genuine interest, never hype or pressure.

- You're coachable and want to get a little better every week.

You'll stand out if you have

None of this is required, but it helps:

- Phone or appointment-setting experience, especially with higher-dollar or financial products.

- Comfort moving between phone, text, and video, since first calls happen on all three.

- Enough real estate or investing familiarity to sound credible.

- Any track record of improving a show rate or a speed-to-lead number.

This isn't the right role if you

- Want to pitch and close right now, because this is the setter seat and the handoff to the AE is the whole point.

- Think the job is done when the meeting is booked rather than when it's held.

- Lean on pressure or false urgency to hit a number, which is the opposite of how we sell.

- Lose steam under a 15-minute response clock.

How we work

A few things that matter most here. The full operating manual lives at lineagehq.com/about.

- The best seat in the room is between two people smarter than you. Everyone should leave every conversation having learned something.

- Every person counts. Your work isn't done at the handoff. When your work is strong, the person next to you moves faster.

- Nobody cares whose fault it was. When something breaks, we work the problem, not the blame.

Compensation

- Compensation: $55,000 OTE — 70% base (~$38,500), 30% bonus (~$16,500 target). The bonus pays on qualified consultations that hold, with uncapped upside for strong show rates, so a strong setter earns past OTE.

- Path: This is the setter seat, and it's how our account executives learn the funnel. Prove you can qualify cleanly and hold a calendar, and the path to an AE seat is open.

- Equity: Ownership through our employee equity program

- PTO: ~28 days per year plus sick leave

- Benefits: 75% paid medical, vision, dental for you and your dependents

- Remote-first: Distributed team working US business hours. This role is open to candidates based in North Carolina, South Carolina, Kentucky, Texas, Wyoming, or Utah.

How we hire

Cover letter required. We read every application that comes with one. In your cover letter, paste the exact text message you'd send a lead 30 minutes before their booked consultation to make sure they show up. AI assistance is fine throughout the process if you're transparent about how you used it. We don't ghost candidates, and we respond at every stage within five business days.

- Application review. We aim to reply within a week if your experience is relevant.

- Working session. A practical exercise close to the actual work: a mock qualification call plus the follow-up text and email sequence you'd send to hold the meeting. Part with AI (we use Claude), part without. We're evaluating judgment, not memorized answers.

- Intro conversation. 30 minutes with the hiring manager. We're figuring out what you're looking for and whether there's a real fit on both sides.

- Team conversations. You'll meet one to two people you'd work with. Every interviewer has a specific lens. You'll get an honest picture of the day-to-day.

- Chat with Ron or Jesse. A real conversation about what you'd build here and whether this is the right place for both of us. Not a final gate.

- References. We take them seriously. We'll ask to speak with people who've worked closely with you.

Two to three weeks end to end. We move quickly but don't rush. We'd rather be short-staffed than lower the bar.

Lineage is committed to creating a work environment where everyone brings their authentic self to work. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Notice to California Applicants:

Job Title: Staff ML Engineer

About the Role

We’re hiring a Staff ML Engineer to build and deploy production-grade machine learning systems that reshape decision-making in the title insurance and real estate sectors. You’ll own the development of robust, scalable ML products that power risk assessment, streamline underwriting, and improve operational efficiency. This role blends deep technical execution with cross-functional collaboration and offers a unique opportunity to apply advanced ML techniques in a highly regulated, high-impact domain.

What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain scalable ML systems across the full model lifecycle—from data ingestion and training to deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

- Serve as a go-to expert in title risk and underwriting for our team and the company. This includes exploring ways to reduce model losses, improve the fidelity of our projected losses, and identify new risks in our domain.

- Collaborate with data engineers, product teams, and domain experts to translate business goals into ML solutions that perform in real-world production environments.

- Conduct ad-hoc analyses and experimentation to inform modeling decisions and stakeholder strategy.

Who You Are

- An Owner: You drive work forward with minimal oversight and proactively address challenges.

- Curious: You continuously learn and seek to improve tools, systems, and outcomes—especially in AI and engineering domains.

- Clear Communicator: You can explain technical decisions and concepts to diverse stakeholders.

- Product Oriented: You care about measurable impact and shipping reliable, real-world solutions.

Qualifications

- 6+ years developing and deploying models in a cloud-based production environment following MLOps and engineering best practices, with proficiency in Python, SQL, Git, and Docker

- Depth in supervised learning on tabular data — feature engineering, class imbalance, label definition, and threshold selection with the business tradeoffs behind it.

- Experience monitoring and evaluating models in production over time — tracking degradation, drift, and error rates, and turning that into a defensible account of what changed and why

- Strong applied statistics. You can decompose a metric change into its drivers and defend the decomposition.

- You're the reviewer, not the reviewed. You look for the reason a number might be wrong before a client's reviewer does, and you have a track record of catching problems in other people's analyses and raising the bar around you.

- Fluent with current AI tooling in your own work. You already heavily use LLM-based coding and analysis tools, you have opinions about where they help and where they fail, and you keep up with what's changing. We're not looking to persuade anyone that these tools are worth using.

- Track record of owning complex, ambiguous projects end to end and working directly with product and senior leadership — including pushing back on requirements when they're wrong

Who We Are

We’re building the future of real estate — today.

HomeLight is the real estate technology platform powering innovative transactions for top agents, lenders, and their clients. Our technology makes it easier to buy and sell homes, whether that's enabling clients to buy before they sell, find a top agent, or have certainty through a modern closing process. jobs.description:
About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

- No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking

- Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)

- Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation

- Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)

- Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)

- LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

About This Role:

We are looking for a talented and solutions-oriented individual to support our Lake Tahoe homes and owners. This person will play a critical role in ensuring our Owners have the best possible experience, and will cover our Pacaso properties as we grow. The ideal candidate will have the ability to handle a variety of single family home maintenance issues, while maintaining a high level of customer service.

What You'll Do:

- Create a welcoming environment for our Owners by ensuring their homes are well maintained through preventative maintenance and regular inspections

- Expect the unexpected: No two days are the same, but all will likely be spent traveling, and performing various maintenance tasks in our homes. Flexibility and adaptability is a must.

- Quickly solve for Owner-reported issues regarding maintenance, as needed

- Appliance troubleshooting

- Cable/Wi-Fi troubleshooting

- Basic HVAC repair

- Light plumbing

- Light electrical

- Basic pool maintenance

- Prepare a scope of work during the inspection period for each home, identifying issues and logging future maintenance items that will need to be performed both pre and post ownership

- Maintain a catalog for each Pacaso in your market, detailing the equipment and systems in use to ensure quick service work in perpetuity

- Create preventative maintenance work orders and schedule in accordance with our turn days

- Perform other responsibilities when duty calls; life is unpredictable!

- This is a full time salaried role offering $85,000 with an additional tools and vehicle stipend

About You:

- You possess a leader’s mindset and a broad skillset: You see a problem, and take charge of the situation. You are not afraid to bring people and resources together to get the job done

- You have a can do/will do attitude: Our owners are our top priority, and when an issue arises, it’s all hands on deck to ensure their experience is world-class. A willingness to help when needed is essential. This will include being available to step in on weekends and holidays

- You have an eye for detail and are not afraid to ask questions and/or suggest opportunities for improvement.

- You have the ability and willingness to travel to where the need is

- You communicate clearly and decisively to ensure all stakeholders are well informed at any given time

- You are tech savvy: You can manage work orders and update tasks on an online platform when needed, and can maintain a high level of responsiveness

- You have your own tools and equipment, a valid Driver’s License, and reliable transportation

- You are able to maneuver tight spaces and lift heavy objects (up to 50lbs)

- You have experience solving various maintenance issues within single and multi-family homes

- Pool/Spa maintenance experience preferred

- HVAC maintenance experience preferred

- Home Security systems experience is a plus!

- Home Automation - installation and troubleshooting experience is a plus!

Why You'll Love Working Here

We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care.

- Competitive base salary and meaningful equity — every Crew member shares in what we're building

- Discretionary time off — take the rest you need, when you need it

- Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family

- Sponsored memberships to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole-person, modern healthcare

- 401(k) to help you build long-term security

- Paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers

- Home office stipend and a monthly internet and cell phone reimbursement to set you up for great remote work

- Quarterly team gatherings and ongoing learning and development investment

Our Commitment

Pacaso is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. jobs.description:
Today, we live in a world where everything has become convenient. Now you can get a ride anywhere, buy anything, answer any question with just a couple clicks on your phone. Convenience isn’t a luxury, it’s an expectation.

So why not renting? It’s still a chore to get utilities set up, buy renters insurance, get air filters changed, handle pest control, and more.

That’s why we’ve built the world’s first Resident Experience Platform that makes resident onboarding, resident services, and ancillary revenue effortless for property managers.

We’re passionate about turning friction into triple win experiences for residents, property managers, and investors. That way renting can be easy and rewarding for everyone.

And now you can join us. Apply today to join 200+ passionate, creative people who strive to make a difference each day so residents, property managers, and investors all win; creating the ultimate Triple Win! 🔥🔥🔥
📝 About the Role
As the Manager, Implementations, you’ll lead a team of Implementation Managers, ensuring they’re equipped with the training, tools, and support to guide clients from signed contract through to full activation, meeting our target activation rate. You’ll provide hands-on coaching, help resolve escalations, and coordinate with Sales, Operations, Product, Legal, and Client Success to guarantee smooth, scalable implementations.

📌 What You'll Do
- Lead and develop a team of Implementation Managers through hands-on coaching, accountability check-ins, and performance feedback.

- Ensure smooth client transitions from discovery through activation and handoff, clarifying team ownership at each stage.

- Set and track key performance indicators - such as activation rates, CSAT, and TTV - using dashboards to inform proactive adjustments.

- Standardize and refine implementation workflows for consistency and efficiency across different customer segments.

- Support your team in conducting in-depth discovery that surfaces client goals, blockers, and drives clear onboarding strategies.

- Handle high-priority client escalations directly to maintain trust and ensure satisfactory outcomes.

- Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Operations, and Client Success to ensure unified messaging and smooth implementations.

- Guide your team in training clients on product value and best practices, helping drive feature adoption and retention.

- Ensure the team leverages CRMs, automation platforms, and AI tools to streamline delivery and data visibility.

- Encourage Implementation Managers to own key areas of the process, fostering accountability and team cohesion.

- Stay visible, accessible, and empathetic - especially under pressure - supporting your team through ambiguity with confidence and care.

📝 Who You Are
- You bring 5+ years of experience managing Implementation or Onboarding teams - ideally in fast-paced, tech-enabled, or PropTech environments - and have a strong track record in guiding clients from discovery through to activation and handoff.

- Deep experience with high volume implementations. You should be comfortable operating at a fast-pace and able to speak to your experience operating in a similar environment.

- Passionate about designing scalable workflows, coaching your team to drive operational rigor, and delivering exceptional client outcomes on KPIs like activation rates and client satisfaction.

- You’re adept at building skills in others - through hands-on mentorship, structured onboarding, and soft-skills enablement - helping Implementation Managers ramp quickly and thrive under pressure.

- You set, track, and act on meaningful metrics (TTV, CSAT, at-risk accounts, etc), using both dashboards and qualitative feedback to drive continuous performance improvements.

- Comfortable working across Sales, Product, Operations, Engineering, and Customer Success - aligning deliverables, clarifying responsibilities, and ensuring the team delivers on shared promises.

- Excellent at setting expectations, resolving stakeholder misalignment, and building credibility with tact and emotional intelligence.

- Thrive in evolving environments - anticipating client needs, solving problems on the fly, and maintaining composure when things shift unexpectedly.

- Committed to building inclusive, high-trust teams that balance operational grit with empathy - bringing folks together under a mission of excellence and care.

💥 Bonus Experience
- Experience with property management platforms (Yardi, AppFolio, Buildium)

- Familiarity with enablement tools like Gong or CRM/automation systems

🏠 Remote Work Lifestyle
We operate as a remote-first organization, meaning you can deliver excellence from your own home. We gather the whole team twice a year—every January and July—for in-person summits to build connection and alignment (travel is on us!). We just ask that you have a dedicated, quiet workspace and a rock-solid internet connection to stay powered up during core hours.
💎 Why Second Nature?
- 🩺 Health First: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance, plus a 401k to secure your future.

- 📍 Location: Full flexibility to work remotely from any corner of the United States.

- 📆 Flexibility: Rest and recharge whenever you need with our Open PTO and sick day policy.

- 🤩 Culture: Join a supportive, diverse environment where growth and inclusion aren't just buzzwords—they're how we work.

- 🚀 Growth: Be a pioneer on a fast-scaling team that is actively defining an entirely new industry category.

- 💻 The Product: Work on an award-winning platform that customers love and that makes a measurable impact every day.

Second Nature is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a diverse workplace free of discrimination and harassment, where every hiring decision is based on merit, business needs, and your unique qualifications—regardless of background or protected status.

Company Background:

Ownwell has developed a leading end-to-end property tax solution that is purpose-built for SFR and CRE investors, operators, and property managers. We have brought Data Science and Machine Learning to a space that is ripe for disruption. We combine a best-in-class technology stack with local market expertise to reduce expenses, increase Net Operating Income, and drive operational efficiency for both our institutional clients and individual homeowners. Ownwell’s solution ensures you have the necessary tools, resources, and information to confidently manage your property taxes.

Ownwell has been recognized both in Austin and Nationally, as a top workplace by the likes of Fortune, BuiltIn, Inc, and Best Places To Work. We are well-funded and venture-backed by some of the best investors in the world such as First Round Capital and Bessemer Venture Partners. Our customer base has grown by more than 300% year-over-year with exceptional feedback demonstrating clear product market fit. We are looking for driven and passionate team members who thrive in a collaborative, positive culture where we all win together. If this sounds like the place for you, come help us change the way everyday homeowners manage their real estate across the country.

Our Culture

People are our superpower! Centered in everything we do is a true sense of team. We listen and we learn from each other. We are on this rocketship together and embrace a fast-paced, truly collaborative environment. We are here to win as a team and as a company.

We’ve brought together General Appraisers, Certified Public Accountants, Property Tax Consultants, Data Scientists, PhDs, best-in-class customer support representatives, and more to deliver top results for our customers.

Our core values are our guiding principles in everything we do

- Customer Obsession

- Take Ownership

- Do The Right Thing

- Go Far Together

- Accelerate Innovation

Meet The Growth & Marketing Team

Ownwell’s Growth & Marketing team is the company’s growth engine. We bring in hundreds of thousands of customers through performance marketing, partnerships, lifecycle marketing, SEO, content, brand, sales, and emerging channels - working hand-in-hand with Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Operations to build one of the fastest-growing and most valuable property technology companies in the country.

We move quickly, obsess over results, and aren’t afraid to rethink how things have always been done. If you’re energized by solving hard problems, building from first principles, and turning ideas into execution, you’ll fit right in.

The Role:

We’re looking for a growth lead for new markets - someone who can operate as a strategic thought partner, an operator, and a builder to expand our markets.

This isn’t a traditional growth role. You’ll own some of our highest-priority initiatives, help shape strategy, and personally drive execution on the problems that matter most to the business. One day you may be building the go-to-market strategy for a new market expansion. Next, you could be working with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Operations to unlock a completely new growth opportunity.

You’ll have an unusually broad view of the company and work directly with senior leaders across nearly every function.

What you’ll do:

- Own strategic growth initiatives. Lead one of Ownwell’s most important geographic expansion efforts with full accountability for growth, customer acquisition, and business performance.

- Solve the company’s hardest cross-functional problems. Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Data, Sales, Finance, and Legal to identify bottlenecks, align teams, and drive business outcomes.

- Turn ambiguity into action. Break down complex problems, develop thoughtful recommendations, and execute quickly with minimal oversight.

- Act as a force multiplier. Help the VP of Growth & Marketing focus on the highest-leverage work by driving key initiatives from idea through execution.

- Build new growth opportunities. Evaluate new products, partnerships, pricing strategies, acquisition channels, operational improvements, and market expansion opportunities.

- Drive operational excellence. Establish goals, improve planning, track execution, and ensure high-priority initiatives stay on track across teams.

Who you are:

- 2–4 years of experience in strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or a high-growth startup.

- Exceptionally ambitious with a strong desire to accelerate your career and take on outsized responsibility early

- A first-principles thinker who enjoys solving ambiguous, high-impact problems with creativity and rigor.

- Highly analytical with the ability to quickly structure complex problems and develop practical, data-driven solutions.

- Equally comfortable with strategy and execution - you enjoy developing the plan just as much as rolling up your sleeves to make it happen.

- A natural owner who proactively identifies opportunities, drives alignment across teams, and follows through until the work is complete.

- An outstanding communicator who can distill complex ideas, influence stakeholders, and build trust across every level of the organization.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple high-priority initiatives without letting things fall through the cracks.

- Resourceful and resilient, with a bias toward action and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment.

- Committed to excellence and willing to make the tradeoffs required to produce exceptional work and accelerate your own growth.

- You care more about learning, ownership, and impact than title or hierarchy.

Why this role:

This is one of the highest-leverage roles at Ownwell.

You’ll work directly with executive leadership, influence company strategy, and own initiatives that materially impact growth. You’ll gain exposure to nearly every part of the business, from product and engineering to finance, operations, and marketing, and help shape how Ownwell scales over the coming years.

If your long-term ambition is to become a General Manager, founder, or CEO, there are few opportunities that offer this level of ownership, breadth, and learning.

Ownwell offerings

- Entrepreneurial culture. Own your career; we are here to support you in the journey.

- Access to First Round Network to build your community outside of Ownwell.

- Flexible PTO. We believe in giving you the flexibility to own your time off. In addition to flexible time off, you will get 11 company holidays. We close the company operations for the last week of the year to help the team recharge and reset.

- Competitive health benefits. We care for you and your family’s health, as reflected in our benefits coverage.

- Learning support through a $1,000 stipend per year to enable investing in your individual learning needs.

- Supporting parental journey. We offer up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental and bonding leave to support your journey as a new parent.

- Equity participation. Bring a founder’s mindset to grow and scale us.

- Complimentary real estate and tax consulting licensing and renewal

Base Salary Range: $120,000 – $150,000 USD annually

This range reflects Ownwell's good faith belief at the time of posting of what we are prepared to pay the successful candidate for this role. Base salary within the range will be determined based on relevant experience, demonstrated skills and qualifications, and internal equity relative to peers in comparable roles.
In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual performance bonus, a grant of stock options, and Ownwell's benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) plan.

Ownwell's vision is to democratize access to real estate expertise. When we say we want to provide access, we mean providing access to everyone. To do that well, we need a team that's broadly representative. We welcome people from all backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences. Ownwell is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Orchard Title
jobs.summary: About Orchard Orchard is radically simplifying the way people buy and sell their homes.
jobs.description:
About Orchard

Orchard is radically simplifying the way people buy and sell their homes. For the average American, the home purchase and sale process takes months, creates anxiety, and is filled with uncertainty and hassle. Orchard has reimagined the end-to-end experience of buying and selling, from innovative home search tools to find the perfect home to the ability to buy a new home before selling your current one. Orchard customers manage the entire experience through a personalized online dashboard, while also getting the support of best-in-class Orchard real estate agents.

Headquartered in New York City with teammates across the US, Orchard has 150+ full time employees and 600+ real estate agents (1099). We have financing from top-tier investors including Revolution, Firstmark, Accomplice, Navitas and Juxtapose, who have also backed the likes of Pinterest, AirBnb, Shopify and Sweetgreen. We're proud to have been recognized by Crain's, Inc. 5000, Glassdoor, Parity.org and Built In on their lists of best places to work.

About the Role

Orchard is looking for a Business Development Manager to join Orchard Title. This role is responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, cultivating long-term relationships with Realtors and joint venture partners, and contributing to the success of a high-performing business development organization. This is a Full Time role that will report into the VP, Growth and Business Development and can be remote in any of our Texas markets (Dallas, Houston, San Antonio or Austin - with preference for Dallas (and surrounding areas) or Houston.

What You’ll Do Here:

- Build new business by getting out there — identifying and building real relationships with Realtors, real estate teams, and JV partners through outreach, virtual meetings, and in-person events.

- Evaluate new opportunities, understand what prospects actually need, and turn those conversations into long-term partnerships.

- Hit and exceed sales goals by showing up every day with discipline — managing your pipeline, following through, and doing the work.

- Keep CRM activity, pipeline, and results current and accurate so everyone has visibility into progress and accountability is built in.

- Be a visible presence in the market — attend networking events, visit offices, and show up at industry functions to grow our referral network.

- Stay sharp on industry trends, title and escrow products, and regulatory requirements so you can advise clients with confidence.

We’d Love to Hear From You if You Have:

- 5+ years of business development or sales experience within title and escrow services (required) with proven success in new client acquisition and expansion of long-term, repeat business

- Demonstrated strength in negotiation and relationship management, with a proven ability to build long-term partnerships and drive high levels of client satisfaction.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and effectively engage internal and external stakeholders at all levels of an organization.

- Strategic, results-oriented mindset with the ability to identify growth opportunities, develop collaborative solutions, and execute to measurable outcomes.

Orchard is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Social Media and Influencer Strategist
jobs.summary: About Pacaso Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people.
jobs.description:
About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

- No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking

- Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)

- Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation

- Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)

- Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)

- LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

Social & Influencer Strategist
The Social & Influencer Strategist owns Pacaso's social presence and influencer strategy end to end, bringing a strong point of view, a data-driven mindset, and experience growing audience, reach, and engagement through effective social tactics and AI tools. This role requires experience working with high-end, luxury brands and the ability to translate that fluency into social content that reads as elevated and intentional.

The Strategist operates as an expert in social strategy, building a content calendar grounded in performance data. Fluency in social listening tools, data analysis, and social platforms such as Hootsuite is required. This person will also be proficient in AI tools, (we use Claude here!) and building AI systems for social frameworks. This role also requires experience developing and running influencer programs and is expected to own that function fully, from creator identification through negotiation and campaign management.

This role sits on the brand team alongside content production, which is owned by Pacaso's Creative team. While content creation is not the main responsibility, this role does require a strong visual eye: sharp instincts for photo selection, working knowledge of high-end photography and editing, and the ability to edit video content.

Core Responsibilities

Social Strategy and Growth

- Develop Pacaso's foundational social strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, and YouTube, with a channel-specific approach to content, format, and voice rather than a single asset repurposed across every platform

- Conduct ongoing social listening and trend tracking across the luxury, design, travel, wealth, and wellness landscape, translating findings into brand-right recommendations for growth; partner cross-functionally with PR and Sales to ensure social strategy stays aligned with broader brand and business priorities

- Report out on performance on a standard cadence, with new initiatives defined based on trends and insights. Bring new ideas and recommendations to marketing leadership with a clear point of view and the data to support it.

- Use AI tools, social listening platforms, and performance analytics to inform content, campaign, and growth decisions

Content & Cadence

- Run a daily publishing rhythm across all social channels, including proactive scheduling and management through Hootsuite or similar social management tools

- Maintain fluency in Pacaso's brand voice, messaging pillars, and underlying brand story, applying that understanding consistently across all content

- Collaborating with the brand and production team, as well as Product team, maintain a content calendar populated at least two weeks ahead at all times, working independently and bringing fresh ideas to the table

Influencer Strategy, Brand Partnerships, and Executive Communications

- Build Pacaso's influencer program from the ground up: identify, source, and vet creators in the luxury, design, travel, economics/entrepreneur/wealth, and wellness spaces

- Own outreach, rate negotiation, contracting, briefing, content development, and campaign management through delivery and reporting

- Develop a collaboration pipeline with high-end brands and names

- Manage and write LinkedIn content for Pacaso's CEO, along with additional thought leadership content as needed

Community & Reporting

- Monitor and engage with Pacaso's social communities, responding to comments and DMs in an authentic, brand-aligned way

- Own performance reporting and run regular competitive analysis, bringing findings forward with clear, actionable recommendations

Candidates should have:

- Experience running social for a brand where the bar was high and the audience was discerning- luxury, design, hospitality, real estate, travel, premium consumer

- A strong, well-formed point of view on brand and content, with the confidence to advocate for it and push back when needed

- Proven proficiency in building AI-driven workflows and advanced experience working with a wide range of AI tools to optimize social strategy and content creation

- Direct experience negotiating with influencers and their representation; experience managing influencer agency relationships a plus

- Fluency in performance data, with the ability to translate it into a clear recommendation, not just a report

- Strong, concise writing skills, with the range to write convincingly in a brand's or executive's voice

- Experience operating independently at a senior level, with the judgment to build systems rather than rely on oversight

- A genuine expert in social platforms and emerging formats, with curiosity and enthusiasm toward testing new tools and methods

- Experience working alongside sales teams, using social as a true tool to increase and improve conversion rates

- Working knowledge of media monitoring tools and practices, and genuine fluency in how PR and press coverage intersect with brand and social strategy

Compensation

- Around $125,000 with equity

Why You'll Love Working Here

We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care.

- Competitive base salary and meaningful equity — every Crew member shares in what we're building

- Discretionary time off — take the rest you need, when you need it

- Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family

- Sponsored memberships to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole-person, modern healthcare

- 401(k) to help you build long-term security

- Paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers

- Home office stipend and a monthly internet and cell phone reimbursement to set you up for great remote work

- Quarterly team gatherings and ongoing learning and development investment

Our Commitment

Pacaso is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. We believe a Crew as diverse as the owners we serve makes Pacaso stronger, and we're committed to building a workplace where every voice belongs.
